input._script:
cmd = "which ncu nsys nvprof nv-nsight-cu-cli 2>&1; ls /usr/local/cuda*/bin 2>/dev/null | head -30; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,clocks.max.sm,clocks.max.mem --format=csv; module avail 2>&1 | head -30"
o = try read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -lc $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String) catch e "ERR " * sprint(showerror, e) end
esc(x) = replace(replace(replace(replace(x, "\\" => "\\\\"), "\"" => "\\\""), "\n" => "\\n"), "\t" => " ")
println("{\"shell\": \"" * esc(o) * "\"}")
